title: econ unit test silently PASSES if catalogs fail to load (early return, no failure)
detail: On catalog-load failure the test returns before any expect, recording a PASS — the exact vacuity class the W3/W5 fixes exist to kill ('a silent episode-free era-2 run can never ship green again'). Sibling a11y_oracle_test.odin:18 correctly uses testing.fail_now for the same condition.
recommended_fix: Replace the print-and-return with testing.fail_now(t, "econ unit cannot load the catalogs") (or expectf e == ""), matching the a11y_oracle_test.odin pattern.

title: Tautological sanity assertion in the anti-vacuity econ test
detail: stats.crises is an i32 counter, so >= 0 can never fail — the assertion is vacuous. Harmless, but iron inside a test whose stated purpose is that 'a silent episode-free era-2 run can never ship green again'.
recommended_fix: Delete the line, or make it bite (e.g. assert a real invariant like stats.draws_ok > 0).
